title: 巴克莱印度CEO：财富管理竞争加剧，靠全球品牌与信任突围
speaker: Pramod Kumar

segments.en: Tell some more about the wealth business right now. It seems like wealth management in India is getting quite intense in terms of competition, especially when it comes to some of these domestic firms that are expanded quite aggressively. How does Barclays stand out?
segments.zh: 谈谈财富业务。印度财富管理竞争相当激烈，尤其是一些国内公司扩张激进。巴克莱如何脱颖而出？

segments.en: Look, we've got a niche private banking offering. We do believe we have a right to win in this segment with a very strong global brand that, you know, epitomizes trust,
segments.zh: 我们提供精品私人银行服务。凭借体现信任的全球品牌，我们相信在这个领域有胜出机会。

segments.en: and also serving global Indians in the corridor between India, Singapore, India, UK, Middle East, so they're clients who really are keen to do business with us because, you know, there's a bank sort of backing behind it and there's an element of trust.
segments.zh: 同时服务印度-新加坡、印度-英国、中东走廊的全球印度人。这些客户愿意与我们合作，因为有银行支持，有信任元素。

segments.en: But, of course, I think the market is becoming competitive, so we've got to be fleet for it.
segments.zh: 当然，市场正变得竞争激烈，我们必须灵活应对。

segments.en: We've got us really designer offerings in line with market expectations, so we're doing all of that for it.
segments.zh: 我们推出符合市场预期的定制化产品，为此全力以赴。

segments.en: Do you have a target in terms of market share? No, not really. I think, you know, we continue to grow and invest in talent and our technology to be able to stay relevant to our clients.
segments.zh: 有市场份额目标吗？没有。我们持续增长，投资人才和技术，以保持与客户的相关性。

segments.en: What about in terms of bankers? Do you think you need to add bankers at this point or invest more? Yes, we have added bankers over the last year, we're investing in technology, we're widening our sort of product offering, so it's a mix of all of that.
segments.zh: 银行家方面呢？需要增加吗？是的，去年我们增加了银行家，投资技术，拓宽产品线，是多管齐下。
